articles.title: Why Local-First Agentic Systems Win on Latency and Trust
articles.nutgraf: Local SQLite state paired with explicit capability manifests eliminates multi-hop cloud orchestration overhead while keeping credential boundaries auditable.

articles.title: Rule of Two in Autonomous Coding Workers
articles.nutgraf: Stripping external write tokens from worker subprocesses ensures that untrusted input ingestion cannot trigger unauthorized outbound mutations.
